**Setting up κ.** With ħ²/(2m₀) = 0.0380998 eV nm², we have κ = √(2m₀φ)/ħ = √(φ / 0.0380998) nm⁻¹.

**Ratio.** Since all other quantities are equal,

I_true / I_calc = exp[−2(κ_true − κ_calc)d]

The difference is κ_true − κ_calc = 0.35642 nm⁻¹. With 2d = 2.00 nm, the exponent is −0.71284, so

I_true / I_calc = exp(−0.71284) ≈ 0.490
